title: Tenant enforcement of inference prefix-cache isolation
hypothesis: A gateway omitting tenant cache partitioning or allowing another tenant's cache salt enables above-chance inference of whether a chosen prompt prefix was processed by that tenant.
null_hypothesis: Cross-tenant prefix membership cannot be distinguished above the pre-registered chance baseline under tested load and noise.
novelty_review: known-class local mechanism study; exhaustive survey pending

tool.name: Inference-cache isolation auditor
tool.status: local prototype implemented; production adapter pending

local_hypothesis: A cache namespace derived only from a caller-controlled salt can share prefix state across tenants; a trusted tenant namespace prevents cross-tenant cache hits in this fixture model.
hypothesis_evaluation: Synthetic namespace and timing mechanism supported; production LLM-serving leakage not evaluated.
